name: Wireless Noise-Cancelling Headphones
description: Premium over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation, 35-hour battery life and comfortable memory-foam ear cushions for all-day listening.

name: Smart Fitness Watch
description: Track workouts, heart rate and sleep. Water resistant to 50 m, vibrant AMOLED display, 7-day battery life and customizable watch faces.

name: Portable Bluetooth Speaker
description: Compact 360-degree speaker with deep bass, IPX7 waterproof rating and 12 hours of playback per charge. Perfect for travel and outdoors.

name: Mechanical RGB Keyboard
description: Full-size mechanical keyboard with tactile switches, per-key RGB backlighting, detachable USB-C cable and a durable aluminium frame.

name: Wireless Ergonomic Mouse
description: Silent-click ergonomic wireless mouse with adjustable DPI up to 2400, a USB nano receiver and a comfortable shape for long work sessions.

name: Classic Cotton T-Shirt
description: Soft 100% ring-spun cotton t-shirt with a regular fit. Pre-shrunk, double-stitched collar and available in several classic colours.

name: Slim-Fit Denim Jeans
description: Mid-rise slim-fit jeans made from premium stretch denim. Features a classic five-pocket design and a zip fly closure.

name: Lightweight Running Sneakers
description: Breathable mesh running shoes with a cushioned EVA midsole, flexible rubber outsole and a padded ankle collar for comfort.

name: Fleece Pullover Hoodie
description: Heavyweight fleece pullover hoodie with a kangaroo pocket, adjustable drawstring hood and ribbed cuffs/hem for a snug fit.

name: Classic Leather-Strap Belt
description: Everyday belt with a brushed-metal pin buckle. Adjustable and available in black and brown to match any outfit.

name: Everyday Urban Backpack
description: Water-resistant city backpack with a padded 15.6-inch laptop compartment, multiple organizer pockets and a side pocket for a bottle.

name: Polarized Aviator Sunglasses
description: Classic metal-frame sunglasses with UV400 polarized lenses that cut glare. Includes a soft storage pouch and cleaning cloth.

name: Slim Bifold Leather Wallet
description: Genuine-leather bifold wallet with six card slots, a transparent ID window and two bill compartments. Slim profile that fits any pocket.

name: Insulated Water Bottle (750 ml)
description: Double-wall vacuum-insulated stainless-steel bottle that keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12 hours. Leak-proof screw cap.

name: Minimalist Analog Watch
description: Stainless-steel case with a genuine leather strap. Japanese quartz movement, 30 m water resistance and a simple clean dial.

name: Automatic Espresso Coffee Machine
description: 15-bar pump espresso machine with a built-in milk frother, a removable 1.5-litre water tank and a stainless-steel body.

name: Eye-Caring LED Desk Lamp
description: Foldable LED desk lamp with three colour modes, stepless brightness control and a built-in USB charging port for your phone.

name: Non-Stick Cookware Set (7 pieces)
description: Seven-piece non-stick cookware set with heat-resistant handles. Compatible with gas, electric, ceramic and induction stovetops.

name: Porcelain Dinner Set for 4
description: Sixteen-piece porcelain dinner set: four dinner plates, four side plates, four bowls and four mugs. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

name: Soy Scented Candle (Vanilla)
description: Hand-poured soy-wax candle in a frosted glass jar. Up to 40 hours of burn time with a warm, calming vanilla fragrance.
